summary: Iteration 37: Batch Management Features for Admin Corridas Dashboard - All features tested and working. Fixed 3 bugs: 1) super_admin role not allowed to create corridas, 2) batch delete endpoint not parsing comma-separated IDs, 3) SelectItem empty value causing React crash.

issues: Console shows hydration error: '<tr> cannot be a child of <span>'. This is a React SSR/hydration warning likely caused by the Emergent editor wrapper, not affecting functionality.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend: Fixed super_admin role check in corridas_eventos_routes.py lines 31 and 155
Backend: Fixed batch delete endpoint to accept comma-separated string instead of List[str]
Backend: Fixed _id exclusion in ranking-corridas/stats aggregation pipeline
Frontend: Fixed SelectItem empty value bug using '__all__' sentinel value
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_ prefixed corridas during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Batch management features fully implemented and tested. SelectItem value='__all__' used as sentinel for 'Todos/Todas' options since empty string is not allowed.

checkbox_individual.details: data-testid='checkbox-corrida-{id}' on each row, toggles individual selection

filter_by_estado.details: Estado dropdown with all 27 Brazilian states, filters table and updates count

filter_by_cidade.details: Cidade dropdown populated from IBGE API after estado selection

sorting_az_za.details: Two sort buttons (ArrowUpAZ/ArrowDownAZ icons) for alphabetical sorting

batch_delete_button.details: Red 'Excluir Selecionadas' button appears when items selected, with confirmation dialog

selection_badge.details: Badge shows 'X selecionada(s)' count when items selected

clear_filters_button.details: 'Limpar' button visible when filters are active

batch_delete_api.details: POST /api/corridas-eventos/excluir-lote accepts comma-separated IDs and deletes successfully
